name: Omega Gravija
doc: Gravija of Omega Weapon / Ultima Weapon (enemy attack 309, c0m114 / c0m090): the screen copied into VRAM (0x240, 0x100), the prim-model layout at the targets' average point, the screen warp around the targets (the warp mesh over their heads and feet, its vertices pushed along their directions by a travelling sine, drawn faded then textured by the screen copy), 0x40 particles circling the average point, the sound; the action results at counter 67. Gravija 311's copy with a real screen warp. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag214_omega_gravija.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools and warp vertices in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

parts.title: Particles
